basic_details.job_title: OUAT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 23 Assistant Professor, Associate Professor Posts
basic_details.post_name: Assistant Professor (Agronomy), Assistant Professor (Soil Science & Agril. Chemistry), Assistant Professor (Horticulture) and 16 more
basic_details.short_information: Odisha University of Agriculture & Technology (OUAT), Bhubaneswar, has invited applications for 23 posts in 19 roles under Advt No. E-II-II-09/2026/17387/UAT. The posts include Assistant Professor (Agronomy), Assistant Professor (Soil Science & Agril. Chemistry), Assistant Professor (Horticulture), Assistant Professor (Genetics & Plant Breeding) and 15 more. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 25 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Green Channel Counter (GCC) / Internet Banking / Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS).

age_limit.age_details: 42 years as on the last date of the application for general candidates

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's and Master's degree in concerned subject with 55% marks, NET/Ph.D. for Assistant Professor; Ph.D. and 8 years experience for Associate Professor

salary_details.pay_scale: Cell-1, Level-10 Rs.57,700 for Asst Professor; Cell-1, Level-13A Rs.1,31,400 for Associate Professor

how_to_apply: Download the application form and information sheet from website ouat.ac.in.
Deposit application fee through Green Channel Counter (GCC) / Internet Banking / RTGS.
Send filled application form with self-attested copies of all certificates and fee deposit receipt to the Registrar, OUAT, Bhubaneswar-751003 by Speed Post or Registered Post.
Superscribe the envelope with APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ... along with advertisement No. and Date.
Make sure it reaches by 25 November 2026.
important_instructions: Candidates should submit separate application for separate post.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in OUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 23 vacancies: 3 Assistant Professor (Agronomy), 1 Assistant Professor (Soil Science & Agril. Chemistry), 2 Assistant Professor (Horticulture), 2 Assistant Professor (Genetics & Plant Breeding), 1 Assistant Professor (Entomology), 1 Assistant Professor (Plant Pathology) and 13 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for OUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (University website ouat.ac.in) and send it to The Registrar, Odisha University of Agriculture & Technology (OUAT), Bhubaneswar-751003, Odisha, by speed post / registered post, to reach by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor: Rs. 700. Associate Professor: Rs. 1000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 42 years as on the last date of the application for general candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Cell-1, Level-10, Rs.57,700 for Assistant Professor (Agronomy), Cell-1, Level-10, Rs.57,700 for Assistant Professor (Soil Science & Agril. Chemistry), Cell-1, Level-10, Rs.57,700 for Assistant Professor (Horticulture), Cell-1, Level-10, Rs.57,700 for Assistant Professor (Genetics & Plant Breeding), Cell-1, Level-10, Rs.57,700 for Assistant Professor (Entomology).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor's and Master's degree in concerned subject with 55% marks, NET/Ph.D. for Assistant Professor; Ph.D. and 8 years experience for Associate Professor. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. In-service candidates shall apply through proper channel with No Objection Certificate (NOC).

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written Test. Interview. Written test and interview for Asst. Professor. Interview only for Assoc. Professor.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bhubaneswar.
